instruction: In VS Code, enable the 'format on save' feature so that code is automatically formatted whenever a file is saved

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling format on save by setting 'editor.formatOnSave' to true in VSCode settings.json. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings metric to verify this boolean setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: enables 'format on save' by checking editor.formatOnSave setting
Getter appropriately fetches VSCode settings.json from correct VM path (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)

Metric check_json_settings properly handles expected parameter: when type='rule', get_rule returns config['rules'] which contains {'expected': {'editor.formatOnSave': true}}, and metric correctly accesses expected['expected']
Data flow is semantically correct: VM file → JSON parsing → key-value comparison
Expected value is correct: true is the proper value to enable format on save
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements verified (single setting)
No postconfig needed: settings.json persists and is accessible after task completion
